title: On Practising the piano two hours a day
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：practise　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 practise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the baker ① practised the piano two hours a day twice over, and every customer in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the baker ② practises the piano two hours a day year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ practise the piano two hours a day at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ practised the piano two hours a day before — a line in the bill for December 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Practising the piano two hours a day twice over, the baker said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ practise as a lawyer in the north town year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Practise as a lawyer in the north town at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the bill, and a new customer from the next bakery ⑧ practises as a lawyer in the north town twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the oven, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ practised the piano two hours a day again when nobody else would.

⑩ To practise the piano two hours a day, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the bakery remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the bakery forgets, somebody practises the piano two hours a day year after year again and somebody must practise the piano two hours a day twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 练习（一般过去式 practised the piano two hours a day：1975 年面点师头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 练习（一般现在 practises the piano two hours a day：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 练习（不定式 to practise the piano two hours a day：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 练习（过去完成时 had practised the piano two hours a day：1969 年十二月的账单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 练习（动名词 practising the piano two hours a day 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 从事（practise as a lawyer in the north town：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去从事在北方城里做律师）
G. v. 从事（practise as a lawyer in the north town：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 练习（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 practises as a lawyer in the north town，而母亲又一次 practised the piano two hours a day）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 practise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the baker practised the piano two hours a day twice over, and nobody in the bakery forgot it.
Even now the baker practises the piano two hours a day year after year whenever the bakery asks.
Practising the piano two hours a day twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever practise as a lawyer in the north town year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next bakery practises as a lawyer in the north town twice over every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother practised the piano two hours a day again, and the bakery remembered that half.
